name: livefoot.fr
body: Every page has a title, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But all touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space.
lesson: Make every link and button at least 24 by 24 px, with space between them.
summary: www.livefoot.fr scores 75 out of 100 (C). 6 checks fail now, 22 are at risk, and 33 pass. Fix first: all touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space.

fix.title: All touch targets must be 24px large, or leave sufficient space
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 60 elements on /, /recherche.php, /wsn/news.php, for example a[href$="recherche.php"] and a[href$="mentions-legales.php"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Make tap targets at least 24 by 24 px, or leave that much space around them.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 42 elements on /, /recherche.php, /wsn/news.php, for example .sd-cmp-VhJqD:nth-child(1) > p and strong. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: 1 internal link leads to an error
fix.fix: Fix or remove each link, or redirect the old address with a 301 to the closest live page.

fix.title: <ul> and <ol> must only directly contain <li>, <script> or <template> elements
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 4 elements on /, /recherche.php, /wsn/news.php, for example .menu-logos. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Keep only li, script, or template directly inside ul and ol.

fix.title: 5 cookies are sent without Secure
fix.evidence: Without Secure: j, w, pre, pre_time and 1 more. Set on /, /wsn/news.php, /coupe-du-monde/actualite/ and 16 more.
fix.fix: Set Secure on every cookie, and HttpOnly plus SameSite=Lax on session cookies.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 3 elements on /, /recherche.php, for example div:nth-child(321) > a[rel="nofollow noopener"][target="_blank"] and div:nth-child(4) > a[rel="nofollow noopener"][target="_blank"]. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

works.title: AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Front-end libraries have no known flaw
Every image has an alt attribute
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
Every page has a meta description
Structured data parses and carries the expected properties
